name: Lemon Coriander Soup
steps: Finely chop the vegetables, ginger and garlic. Wash coriander well; chop the stems separately from the leaves. Mix cornflour with 50 ml of the measured cold water.
Heat oil and soften onion for 3 minutes without browning. Add ginger, garlic and coriander stems for 1 minute, then carrot and cabbage for 2 minutes.
Add the remaining water, salt and pepper. Simmer for 8 minutes until vegetables are tender with a little bite. Stir the slurry again, pour it in and simmer for 2 minutes until lightly glossy.
Turn off the heat and add lemon juice and coriander leaves. Taste and serve immediately; adding lemon at the end keeps the soup bright and fresh.
notes: Base recipe for 4 adults. Cooking times are estimates; follow the texture and doneness cues. Jain suitability follows your saved ingredient choices.
